passages.title: Into Aegwynn's Retreat
passages.text:
If we're going to defeat that demon, we need something to put us on its level. Something... powerful...

<Khadgar looks thoughtfully at Atiesh, his staff.>

You need a weapon. Something of great power. And if my assumptions are correct, it shouldn't be too far from here.

I can send you to go find this weapon. Speak with me when you're prepared.

passages.title: Journey to Azsuna
passages.text:
<class>t, I've obtained word that Archmage Khadgar has been able to form a portal that will enable access to the isle of Azsuna. He requests an audience with you at the earliest opportunity.

The Kirin Tor have also constructed a permanent waygate to enable speedy movement between here and Dalaran - you can find it near the path down in the village should you wish to use it.

passages.title: Black Rook Guard
passages.text:
Inside the chest, hidden amongst various knickknacks, is a signet engraved with a unique crest.

The band, made from a silvery, unbreakable metal, has been worn down by time, as if absently twisted and rubbed against its owner's finger.

passages.title: Building Our Troops
Tracking Down the Scepter
passages.text: The logbook contains the latest information on the Scepter of Sargeras. It appears to have been written by an extremely agitated, excited, or psychotic imp and is barely legible. Take this to Calydus for translation.

passages.title: Salvation
passages.text:
The valley is swarming with fel-corrupted creatures who are beyond saving, yet there still may be some that could use our help.

Take this manaroot salve and apply it to any animals you see. If the fel magic hasn't taken hold, the salve might be able to mend their wounds.

passages.title: First Impressions
Blood Bonded
The Final Verse
Ain't No Place Like Home
passages.text:
Let me tell you, this is a big place, this Arathi Highlands, and I've no doubt at some point you are going to need to quick step it back to our lovely new base.

How about I help you out with that?

passages.title: Ain't No Place Like Home
passages.text: You know what you need? You need a good, easy way to get back to me to buy your things whenever you want. I can help ya there.
